shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Lift a working sheet from the workspace

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One primary action per form or record list.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#196369; color:#fffef9; border:1px solid #196369; border-radius:.25rem; padding:.57rem 1rem; font-weight:650; cursor:pointer } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#104b50 } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a74a28; outline-offset:3px }

components.name: Module Index Link
components.description: A clear route into one existing working module.
components.css: .ds-module-link { display:block; padding:1.25rem 1.4rem; background:#fffef9; color:#18383b; border:1px solid #cdd3c9; font:700 2rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-decoration:none } .ds-module-link:hover { background:#eaf1e9 } .ds-module-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a74a28; outline-offset:3px }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A field on a working sheet.
components.css: .ds-label { display:grid; gap:.35rem; color:#18383b; font:700 .87rem system-ui,sans-serif } .ds-input { padding:.64rem .8rem; border:1px solid #97aaa7; border-radius:.2rem; color:#18383b; background:#fffef9; font:400 1rem system-ui,sans-serif } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a74a28; outline-offset:3px }

narrative.overview: An indexed working archive, not a marketing dashboard. Navigation identifies the current module; sheets give forms and records a quiet, repeatable work surface.
dos: Do describe only implemented modules and indicate accounts awaiting permissions.
Do use meaningful customer/provider names instead of IDs in UI choices.
donts: Don't present manual quotation totals as calculated tax-inclusive amounts.
Don't fabricate sales figures, inventory alerts or order states.
